summary: Freebuff is a free coding agent available as a CLI, desktop app, web app builder, cloud IDE, and chat. Text ads fund access to its model catalog instead of a subscription. Its free daily allowance of 150 Freebucks covers up to 15 hours of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash per day (or a mix of other models such as GLM 5.3 Flash and MiMo 2.6 Flash). Supported regions receive full access; other regions and VPN users get a limited daily allowance.
claim_steps: Install the CLI (Node.js 18+): npm install -g freebuff
Run freebuff and describe what you want — no account to create, no API key, no credit card.
Or use another Freebuff product: Desktop (freebuff.com/desktop), Web (freebuff.com/web), Cloud (freebuff.com/cloud), or Chat (freebuff.com/chat).
